description: Find products sold in the UAE and their lowest current price across Amazon.ae and noon, with whether that price is a good one. Use for any shopping question in the UAE: "best air fryer under 400 AED", "PS5 controller price Dubai", "Lattafa perfume", "baby formula 800g". Understands plain language and Arabic; a budget in the query ("under 300", "between 100 and 200") is applied as a price filter.

category.description: Optional category slug or name from list_categories, e.g. "laptops", "perfumes", "air-fryers".

query.description: What the shopper wants, in their words (English or Arabic). A budget in it is understood.

shop.description: Optional: only products this shop sells.

name: search_products
title: Search UAE products and prices
